decision.observation: The goose holds the boot in front of the closed X-braced gate; above it, thick branches arch. The path runs south from the gate. The gate has never opened after exhaustive attempts from both sides.
decision.hypothesis: This gate is a shortcut, not the boundary; the true exit is the stepping stones at the pond's north edge (top of the map), which were never stepped on. Route: head northwest past the stump and plank up to the stream/log crossing, then west to the pond's stones.
decision.memory: Both sides of this gate are reachable by walking; pond stepping stones remain the unexplored frontier.
